title: Market Day
summary: A pixel town seen from above: soft path and pond borders, a fence, crops, houses and trees as set pieces, villagers in four facings; a coin grab with friends.

verified.how: node bin/gamesfun.mjs create <dir> --from market-day, then node builder/tools/verify.mjs <dir> (148 s) under gpu-run.sh on Linux with a desktop GPU (ANGLE on GL/EGL); the first run failed gates A, B (the new shadows carried no slot) and F (a spawn walled in by a rock), fixed, then passed
